scope: Seven static native branch-reference pages plus a catalog presentation model. This is not the complete graphical Armory or a release/promotion receipt.

source_checks.purchase_model_agreement: 300 catalog-state scenarios checked against generated HSC purchase outcomes across all 50 nodes.

compile.evidence: Sapien compile/save and local compiled-tag readback verify the recorded hash, new scripts, counts and all 128 titles.

page_layout.evidence: page-0.png through page-6.png inspected at full size. All weapon capstones and all eight support nodes fit, without clipping or overlap with selected CHUD detail.
page_layout.line_breaks: Ordinary LF was ignored; literal |n was proven in a separate native two-panel probe and is emitted by the authoring layer.
page_layout.remaining: Thin pale/gray text has insufficient contrast on bright textured terrain. No accessibility or other-resolution claim.

assertions.name: held-next
assertions.observation: Holding Space for 1.2 seconds advances one node.

assertions.name: held-buy
assertions.observation: Holding the primary trigger for 1.2 seconds buys one Power rank and spends one point.

assertions.name: stage-locked
assertions.observation: Stage-one Seeker attempt preserves rank zero and points.

assertions.name: prerequisite-locked
assertions.observation: Stage-two Seeker attempt without Cadence preserves rank zero and points.

assertions.name: branch-purchased
assertions.observation: Buying Cadence then Seeker updates both ranks and spends exactly three points.

assertions.name: exclusive-locked
assertions.observation: Crystal remains rank zero after selecting Seeker; points unchanged.

assertions.name: points-locked
assertions.observation: An unaffordable Power rank is rejected without mutation.

assertions.name: category-chord
assertions.observation: Real Space+Q input selects the next weapon category.

assertions.name: resumed
assertions.observation: Real 1 key closes Armory and advances gameplay time; reference page absent in the capture two seconds later.

assertions.name: reopened
assertions.observation: Real Space+Q reopens Armory at the retained category.

assertions.name: page-soak
assertions.observation: After 25 seconds of uninterrupted refresh the Armory remains active with a bounded page clock and a visible page.

assertions.name: save-before
assertions.observation: Prepared stage-two checkpoint: 430 total seconds, 81.25 XP, seven points, AR unlocked, Needler Power rank two, 123 shots.

assertions.name: save-actors-before
assertions.observation: Seventeen native enemies present before checkpoint restart.

assertions.name: save-after
assertions.observation: The saved stage, timer, XP, points, weapon unlock/rank and shot counter survive a full launcher/native process restart.

assertions.name: save-actors-after
assertions.observation: Seventeen native enemies remain after Continue.

assertions.name: save-camera-after
assertions.observation: Continue restores the stage-two overhead camera range.

assertions.name: save-clock-paused
assertions.observation: Armory keeps timer and shots paused after Continue.

assertions.name: save-resume-works
assertions.observation: Real 1 key resumes timer and automatic shots after Continue.

runtime_log_review.scope: Filtered debug_full log review; stock Jackal model warnings remain. This does not establish absence of all warnings or measure frame pacing.

excluded_attempts: The first plain-LF probe concatenated text; superseded by the verified |n probe.
Initial page setup let console number keys reach menu input. Rerun with gameplay input suspended during setup and native action tests reset.

The first held-click assertions failed because the temporary QA helper reused sv_arm_result, which sv_reset_actions overwrites, leaving sv_running false. Corrected helper and reran held input and all dependent purchase checks from explicit initial state. No game change was made to hide this failure.
native_sdk.qa_method: Visually confirmed the H3 prompt before command batches and inspected each final assertion. Console setup/checks temporarily suspend sv_running; the corrected helper preserves it in sv_key_category, resets actions, and restores it. Real input tests run with sv_running true. Temporary setup is confined to the isolated QA profile.

production_restore.visible_continue_verification: Passed: original v0.4 Armory and overhead view visible after Continue.

save_compatibility: One added page-clock global, changed HSC/scenario and new UI strings alter the exact-build fingerprint. This candidate uses its own QA core; existing production cores are not migrated.
not_run: Full ordinary four-stage run and balance
remaining: Live purchased/available/locked styling across every node and direct graphical selection
Continuously visible selected next cost, rank and points
